behavior.reads: Append symbol-scoped commissionRate to the five existing signed capacity GETs, after public cap validation. Exact financial JSON accepts original numeric tokens or decimal strings; require matching symbol and rate in [0,1). Refusal, identity change, timeout, missing/invalid fee fail without fake zero. Capacity read up to six signatures; full account refresh up to ten. No signing triggered by observation. Official commissionRate request weight is 20; all-account openOrders remains weight 40. No polling is added.
behavior.fill: Separate buy and sell full-fill assumptions, no mutation of original account, quantity or order intent. Same-side weighted signed entry value, partial reduction realizes only the closed amount, exact close has no residual estimate, reverse starts new entry at assumed fill. Taker fee applies to whole fill in cross-wallet projection.
behavior.price: Entered limit; market uses the existing direction-specific MainOrderPriceAssumption including public Web buy factor; conditional market uses trigger; trailing uses explicit activation. Automatic trailing has no fixed future execution price and displays —. These are hypotheses, not fill constraints.
behavior.isolated: Use only target leg isolated wallet, plus incremental opening cost. Partial reduce releases proportional wallet for either sign and charges any loss not covered by released collateral to the remainder. Reversal releases the old leg before new remainder margin plus adverse opening loss allocation and any uncovered old loss. This derives explicit sign-safe accounting rather than copying public JS signed division/reversal expressions, which are ambiguous for shorts and leverage; real platform agreement remains unverified. Fees follow the public wallet projection into cross balance, rather than silently deducting a second time from isolated wallet.
behavior.cross: Shared margin-asset cross wallet after realized PnL/fee, Mark-only PnL and maintenance of other contracts; target hedge keeps unchanged opposite leg. Sizing continues using min(Mark,Last); liquidation does not reuse that conservative sizing PnL.
behavior.multi: Eligible marginAvailable assets only; equity uses bid for assets/ask for liabilities, maintenance uses ask. Recompute target collateral sign at the solved price. Other asset equity/maintenance and current FX held fixed; missing or stale rates yield no estimate.
behavior.solver: Rational quantities, signed entry values and wallet allocations. Merge all active legs risk floor/cap price boundaries; solve equity(P)=maintenance(P) exactly in every interval and collateral-sign branch, validate positive candidate in same tiers and select nearest Mark boundary. Require continuous risk schedules starting at zero; never extrapolate above published caps or round intermediate values.
behavior.presentation: Existing directional panels gain the PRD post-fill liquidation row. Blank/zero/invalid/oversized inputs or absent fresh complete facts display —. Rounded once for display at symbol price precision and shared fixed formatter. Labels and assumptions EN/ZH. No new submit/review fields beyond requested PRD panel.
behavior.validity: Original 30s signed account lease and 10s public quote checks preserved by production pricing provider. Account/identity/configuration changes invalidate; observation/signing does not extend lease. Existing frozen confirmation/submission and original-ID recovery unchanged.
